steps.domain_action: initialize the Lean environment and import the linear algebra library
define the real numbers as a vector space over the rational field
invoke the existence of a Hamel basis via the Axiom of Choice
fix the basis B as a permanent reference for the coordinate system
partition the vector space based on the parity of the sum of coordinates
select the subset S where the sum of coordinates is odd
assume two elements x and y exist in S
compute the sum x + y in the coordinate representation
observe that the sum of coordinates for x + y is even
conclude that x + y cannot be in S
rejoin the parity branches to confirm the partition covers the space
hold the complement of S as the candidate for the sum-free property
record the lemma stating S is sum-free
close the proof script with the QED symbol
